overview: The Climate Equity Council approved past minutes, scheduled future meeting dates, and discussed community outreach strategy regarding city waste policy, energy aggregation, and smart meter rollouts.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The council approved the minutes from its November and December meetings.

items.title: Meeting Schedule
items.summary: The council scheduled upcoming meeting dates for February 11, March 18, and April 29.

items.title: Climate Connectors Role Expansion
items.summary: The council discussed expanding Climate Connector duties to include meeting co-chairing, quarterly event planning, and drafting educational materials.

items.title: West Medford Community Center Event Planning
items.summary: Members discussed event ideas for the West Medford Community Center, focusing on senior-targeted programs like energy bill checkups and food waste reduction.

items.title: Trash Collection Policy and Public Feedback
items.summary: The council reviewed community outreach efforts and feedback concerning proposed changes to the city's waste collection schedule.

items.title: Annual Council Objectives and Community Cleanups
items.summary: Members brainstormed goals for the year, including participating in the May 2 citywide cleanup and promoting waste reduction and tree-watering volunteers.

items.title: Electricity Aggregation and Smart Meters
items.summary: Brenda Pike updated the council on corrective letters issued for an electricity aggregation mailing error and provided details on National Grid's upcoming smart meter installations.

items.title: Solar Grants, High School Planning, and Facilities Staffing
items.summary: The council received updates on solar grant applications for school roofs, sustainability planning for the new high school, and the hiring of new facilities managers.

items.title: Future Meeting Topics
items.summary: Members briefly outlined future discussion topics, including utility scam prevention and winter energy bill support, prior to adjournment.
